title: Complete Campus Network Index | Saylani Mass IT Training
text:
Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT) operates 50 campuses across Pakistan, in the following cities/areas: Abbottabad, Balochistan, Balochistan (Kharan), Balochistan (Washuk), Faisalabad, Ghotki, Gujranwala, Hyderabad, Islamabad, Karachi, Lahore, Lakki Marwat, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta, Rawalpindi, Sukkur, Turbat, Waziristan.

Karachi: Head Office; Numaish Campus; Gulshan Campus; Malir Campus; Aliabad Female Campus; Paposh Campus; Zaitoon Ashraf IT Park; SBIL (Saylani School of Business and Islamic Leadership); North Karachi Campus; Saylani Hajiyani Sakeena IT Campus; Saylani TITAN Zamzama Campus; SVTI Gulshan Campus; ASF Campus; DHA Phase 7 Female Campus; Bahria College DHA Phase 2 Campus; Bahria College Nore 1 Campus; Bahria Subh-e-Nau Secondary Campus; Bahria College 1 Majeed SRE Campus; Bahria College 2 Majeed SRE Campus; Bahria College KNCRE Agrataj Campus; Bahria College Hanif SRE Campus; Bahria College Khalid SRE Campus; Bahria Community Centre Campus; Bahria College Karsaz.
Faisalabad: Faisalabad Campus.
Hyderabad: Sarfraz Campus; Memon Society Campus; Autoban Campus.
Peshawar: Mohsin and Huma Campus.
Quetta: Quetta Campus.
Islamabad: F-10 Markaz Campus.
Rawalpindi: Rawalpindi Campus; DF Army Public School Campus; ASF Public School Rawalpindi.
Gujranwala: Gujranwala Taj Campus; Gujranwala QDPS Campus.
Sukkur: Saylani TITAN Sukkur Campus.
Lakki Marwat: Mohsin and Huma Campus (Lakki Marwat).
Multan: Saylani IT Park Multan.
Ghotki: SMIT Ghotki Campus.
Turbat: Turbat Campus.
Abbottabad: PMA Kakul Campus.
Lahore: GOC Lhr LGITE 11 Div Campus; ASF Public School & College Lahore; Mehfooz Shaheed Garrison Campus.
Waziristan: Waziristan Wana Campus; Wana Campus.
Balochistan: Balochistan Campus.
Balochistan (Washuk): Washuk Campus.
Balochistan (Kharan): Kharan Campus.

Full campus list with addresses and maps: https://www.saylanimit.com/campuses. Students can select their nearest campus during enrollment at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
